KNOW YOUR WAY OUT

W A S D Move · walk up and down stairs
MOUSE Look · drag if cursor stays visible
SHIFT Sprint — makes noise
SPACE Jump over small walls and hedges

F Toggle torch

ESC / P Pause

Security patrols the wings and pursues on sight.

Deva asylum ghost senses you through walls. Aim your torch at it to slow it down.

Explore the ground floor, first floor, west basement and the two rooms above Reception. Walk the Reception stair to reach the second-floor landing; the west junction stair connects basement, ground and first floors. Press E at a marked exit to step onto its outside landing or path, then press E at the same door to return inside. Follow the outside stairs to the grounds and reach the front path to escape. Hold E to inspect artwork; release E to return. Every NPC pauses while E is held. The notebook records explored rooms, routes and inspected documents; its maps reveal nearby areas as you walk. Reading it pauses the game. You have a five-second head start. The internal room divisions and characters are fictional.
